en.t: Last year, his father passed away.

units.source_text: 然而，他从远方回到阔别三年的家里来，

en.t: However, he came back from far away to the home he had been separated from for three years,

units.source_text: 既不是为了前来探视火灾过后的情景，

en.t: not in order to see what things looked like after the fire,

units.source_text: 也不是为了前来吊唁父亲之死。

en.t: nor in order to mourn his father's death.

units.source_text: 他的心情仅是路过而已。

en.t: In his heart, he felt as if he were merely passing through.
